description: List your alerts in this workspace, newest first. `kind` says what happened: a mailbox stopped working (`mailbox_failed`), got worse at warmup (`mailbox_health`), is full (`mailbox_full`), or its domain's grace for failing DNS records ends soon (`domain_grace_ending`); a change made in the Inbox that the mailbox kept refusing was given up (`relay_gave_up`); a campaign paused itself (`campaign_paused`) or its new leads wait on address checks (`campaign_checks_held`); a batch of address checks you started waits on hold (`email_check_run_held`); a tracking domain stopped pointing at us (`tracking_domain_failing`); we limited what the workspace sends, or lifted that (`workspace_posture`, with `state` and the reason); we switched the workspace's webhook off after failed deliveries (`webhook_disabled`); a person replied (`reply_received`); someone asks you to review a draft (`draft_review`) or to do what a key can't: connect a mailbox, replace its logins, set up its bounce reports, send a lead anyway, change the team or the plan (`handoff_requested`). `unread` in the answer counts every unread alert, not only this page's. Each alert names what to open: a mailbox, a campaign, a thread, a draft, a handoff, a tracking domain or the import a batch checks. Listing marks nothing read.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

unread.description: true: only the alerts you have not marked read yet. Left out or false: all of them.

name: list_alerts
title: List alerts
